name: General Marcus Jonathan
summary: At Stormwind's gates, General Marcus Jonathan guards the capital and weighs pleas for aid from frontier settlements. He is a veteran of the Second War, commands Stormwind Defense, and oversees the garrison.

sections.title: Commander of the Gates
sections.body: General Marcus Jonathan commands Stormwind's defense from horseback in the Valley of Heroes. As the highest-ranking officer at the city gates, he is the capital's first line of defense. During the Second War, he fought beside soldiers such as Reginald Windsor under General Turalyon. Now he must guard the capital as frontier towns, including Lakeshire, make ever more desperate appeals for help.

sections.title: A Strained Command
sections.body: General Marcus Jonathan assures local magistrates that he is committed to helping towns such as Lakeshire repel Blackrock orcs and gnolls. In private, he confides that the court has grown distant and the boy-king's regency behaves strangely.

faq.q: Where can I find General Marcus Jonathan?
faq.answer: General Marcus Jonathan rides just inside Stormwind City's main gates, overlooking the entrance bridge in the Valley of Heroes.

faq.q: What is Marcus Jonathan's military history?
aliases: did marcus fight in the second war
faq.answer: General Marcus Jonathan served under General Turalyon during the Second War and fought beside comrades such as Reginald Windsor. He eventually rose to become the High Commander of Stormwind Defense.

angles.text: As an Alliance fighter, you can see Stormwind's martial pride in Marcus Jonathan, who guards the capital's gate.
As a warrior, you can look to General Marcus Jonathan, commander of Stormwind's gates and a Second War veteran, as an example of the kingdom's martial duty in its infantry ranks.
